briefing.step1: Harness on. Always keep at least one carabiner clipped in.
briefing.step2: One person per obstacle, three per platform.
briefing.step3: Only push off the Flying Fox once the landing is clear.
briefing.step4: If you freeze up, breathe [R] until it passes.
briefing.gate: Clip in at the practice anchor to finish the briefing [F]

options.audio.futureNote: Ambience and interface sounds are not implemented yet (planned for M2) – these two sliders are wired to the mixer and ready for them.
options.camera.reducedCameraMotionDesc: Calms the camera's fall shake and nerve-driven sway to almost nothing.
options.camera.reducedMotionDesc: Stops the heartbeat dot and other HUD pulses from animating.
options.gameplay.assistDesc: Softer balance disturbance from steps, leaning and hurrying (x0.6) and a wider slip window before letting go. Strength and nerves are unaffected.
options.gameplay.localeNote: Route names and prompts pick up the new language as they next redraw; a few one-time screens (the ticket desk, stamp card) keep the old language until you reload.
options.gameplay.colourShape: Every route colour also carries its own shape (● ■ ◆) on signs, the course map and stamps – colour is never the only cue.
options.gameplay.sharedPhysicsDesc: Co-op only: on the two co-op obstacles, and on elements that share a support tree, each climber's steps also nudge the other's wobble a little. Off means every element wobbles only for whoever is actually on it.
options.controls.note: Read-only for now – remapping is prepared but not wired up yet.
kassa.ticket.season.name: Season pass
kassa.ticket.season.desc: Open all day, no clock – explore, watch, hunt legendary routes.
kassa.gear.none.name: None
kassa.gear.gloves.name: Gloves
kassa.gear.gloves.desc: More grip, less grip drain – but slower to re-clip.
kassa.gear.shoes.name: Light shoes
kassa.gear.shoes.desc: Steadier balance – but a pull-up after a fall costs more strength.
kassa.gear.trolley.name: Fast trolley
kassa.gear.trolley.desc: More top speed on the Flying Fox – harder to brake cleanly.
kassa.coopToggleDesc: Controller joins as climber 2 – keyboard and mouse stay climber 1.
